title: DeepSeek doubles funding round to 100bn yuan as valuation holds steady
key_facts: DeepSeek is nearing completion of its second funding round, which has doubled to 100 billion yuan (HK$117.27 billion) in half a month, with pre-money valuation unchanged at about 500 billion yuan (mainland media reported).

The money is split roughly equally between existing and new shareholders; new investors include Stony Creek Capital, China Fortune-Tech Capital, CPE Asset Management, Legend Capital and Geely; existing ones include CATL, Tencent, IDG Capital, Lux Capital and Silicon 100.
CATL put in about 5 billion yuan in the first round and plans another 10 billion yuan in this one.
If completed, total capital raised reaches 150 billion yuan in six months, the largest primary-market financing in China this year.
First round, in April, raised over 50 billion yuan at a valuation above 350 billion yuan and closed in late June; the second round launched in July at 500 billion yuan.
After the round DeepSeek is expected to finalise a restructuring and, guided by institutions such as CITIC Securities, prepare an IPO on the Science and Technology Innovation Board.

Bloomberg reported that DeepSeek agreed to lead a seed round of tens of millions of dollars in robotics AI start-up Winverse AI, valued at about US$400 million; DeepSeek earlier took a 2 percent stake in Unitree Robotics.
quote_evidence: DeepSeek is nearing the completion of its second funding round with the total amount raised doubling to 100 billion yuan (HK$117.27 billion) in just half a month, while its pre-money valuation remains unchanged at approximately 500 billion yuan, mainland media reported.
If completed, the deal would bring DeepSeek's total capital raised to 150 billion yuan within just six months, marking the largest primary market financing in China this year.

Upon completion of this second round, DeepSeek is expected to finalize a corporate restructuring and, with the guidance of institutions such as CITIC Securities, prepare for an initial public offering on the Science and Technology Innovation Board.
why_it_matters_hint: A round of this size would be the largest private financing in China this year and moves DeepSeek toward a listing.
notes: The Standard relays unnamed mainland media; no DeepSeek confirmation in the text. Score lowered one point for that (single relayed, unconfirmed report).
